source.note: Institution-level Key Stage 2 attainment from the DfE Explore Education Statistics API. Built for parental choice comparison, not school governance. Progress measures are sparse for 2024/25 because of missing KS1 baselines. On-demand local authority pack: Kent (seed maintained set remains Hampshire).  Secondary-age state and independent schools carry Key Stage 4 and 16–18 (A-level) outcomes where published (nil/zero English & maths GCSE returns cleared; EBacc subject pillars used as fallbacks when possible). Independents also carry Ofsted grades for non-association schools and GIAS inspectorate/website links for ISI schools (ISI search prefers postcode).

independent.note: Mean of independents in this index with usable KS4 figures (nil/zero returns removed); KS5 means use A-level APS where published

stateKs4.note: Mean of state schools in this index with usable KS4 figures (nil/zero returns removed); KS5 means use A-level APS where published

phonics.note: DfE publishes phonics screening results for England and local authorities only — not for individual schools. KS1 teacher assessment is no longer collected nationally (from 2023/24).
